text: In 2021-07 we converged on infrastructure. On 2021-07-01, 54 of us said "the invest in america act," a phrase first spoken 2019-04-10 by John B. Larson. That same day, 25 of us said "and water infrastructure," 25 said "roads bridges transit," and 22 said "transportation and infrastructure." Twenty-one of us said "roads bridges transit rail," 21 said "in the invest in america act," 20 said "the invest in america act is," and 20 said "of the invest in america." Every peak fell on 2021-07-01. We were, on that day, a single instrument tuned to one bill and the surfaces it named: roads, bridges, transit, rail, water. The record shows we said the act's name more than we said anything else, and we said it together.
